children.description: The shipping option's ID.

children.description: The name of the shipping option.

children.description: The shipping option's price type.

children.name: service_zone_id
children.description: The associated service zone's ID.

children.name: service_zone
children.description: The service zone details.

children.name: fulfillment_set_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment set associated with the service zone.

children.name: shipping_profile_id
children.description: The ID of the associated shipping profile.

children.name: provider_id
children.description:
The ID of the associated fulfillment provider. It's used to calculate
the shipping option's price, if it's price type is `calculated`, and later
it processes shipments created from this shipping option.

children.name: data
children.description:
Custom additional data related to the shipping option, useful for the fulfillment provider
to process the shipping option and calculate its price.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/fulfillment/shipping-option#data-property).

children.name: type
children.description: The shipping option's type.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the shipping option type.

children.name: label
children.description: The label of the shipping option type.

children.name: description
children.description: The description of the shipping option type.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the shipping option type.

children.name: provider
children.description: The associated fulfillment provider details.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the provider.

children.name: is_enabled
children.description: Whether the provider is enabled.

children.name: rules
children.description: The shipping option rules associated with the shipping option.

children.name: attribute
children.description: The name of a property or table that the rule applies to.

children.name: value
children.description: The value of the rule.

children.name: operator
children.description: The operator of the rule.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount for the shipping option, which can be flat rate or calculated.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Indicates whether taxes are included in the shipping option amount.

children.name: calculated_price
children.description: The calculated price for the shipping option, if its `price_type` is `calculated`.

children.name: calculated_amount
children.description: The calculated price.

children.name: is_calculated_price_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether the calculated price includes taxes. If enabled, Medusa will
infer the taxes from the calculated price. If false, Medusa will
add taxes to the calculated price.

children.name: stock_location
children.description: The details of the associated stock location, which is set if the shipping option's `price_type` is `calculated`.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the stock location.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the stock location.

children.name: address
children.description: The address of the stock location.

children.name: fulfillment_set_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment set associated with the stock location.
